text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while Fine Motion is making progress with her training…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt… Bzzzt…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Apologies for messaging you out of the blue, Trainer. I have a request, if you don't mind."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Would it trouble you to become my family?"

text_block_list.name: Diner Staff
text_block_list.text: Welcome! How many today?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Two, please…

text_block_list.name: Diner Staff
text_block_list.text: …Everything okay?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh? Don't you need to verify our familial relation? This is my stepbrother.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh? Don't you need to verify our familial relation? This is my stepsister.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Isn't that right, dear brother? ♪ We can definitely eat here, seeing as we're family!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Isn't that right, dear sister? ♪ We can definitely eat here, seeing as we're family!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …I finally get a grasp on the situation. It seems she has taken the term "family restaurant" to mean only family can dine there.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, of course. I know you don't need any qualifications to enter a family restaurant.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Since friends can go together, it would be peculiar for entrance to be restricted to families, right? Still, I wondered why they were called that.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Then I thought that families might receive some kind of special service, so I wanted to test my theory. I thought it was a rather clever idea.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! As thanks for escorting me here, let me treat you to a "mystery drink." ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Groove was telling me about a child who pressed all the buttons on the soda dispenser—wait, was she saying that was bad? Eh, it'll be fine! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I brace myself for my "thank-you gift," I take a look around the restaurant.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion's security team is seated at a nearby table. It seems she requires protection even when going out for a meal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way back from the restaurant…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Look, Trainer! I made this purchase all by myself!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I learned all the steps to making purchases—from locating my wallet to exchanging money for goods. This was my first successful attempt!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Spending one's allowance on snacks is a staple of youth, right? Would you call me a full-fledged student now?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Huzzah! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion is overjoyed about buying snacks. I'm watching the heartwarming display with a smile when…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, I got too excited again. My friends just talked to me about this too.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: They said I smile at the weirdest times.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I realized I must be making people uncomfortable and promised myself I'd be careful, but… I must admit, it slipped my mind.
choice_data_list: I think they meant it's wonderful that you find joy in so much.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …Aah, ahaha. Yes, I see. What an exquisite interpretation!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Well then! After we finish these snacks, would you care to go for a little stroll?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'm truly grateful to you for training me with so much care.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: When I was living in the castle, my family and my security team were always thinking up all kinds of ways to keep me from getting bored.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Their efforts are what gave birth to my love of all things fun. All of my memories are full of love and affection!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I never even imagined wanting to leave—not even once.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You know, I actually have an elder sister who's an active racer.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: When she told me that she was leaving the castle to pursue her career, she asked if I wanted to go with her.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I refused her at the time. I believed that fulfilling my duty was more important.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That duty… is to become a pillar of Ireland's prosperity.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Indeed. If I deem it essential to perform that duty, I'm prepared to drop everything and return home at a moment's notice.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'm only talking about my dedication, of course. If I was told to go home right away… I'd surely try to persuade them to reconsider.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: There's still so much I want to learn about Japan! I think it's a splendid thing to travel the world and see it with your own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It is not enough just to know the world intellectually. By touching, confirming, and experiencing, I've finally learned what true enjoyment is.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You're right! They're an incredible experience that you can feel with your own legs!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It's something that you can't comprehend unless you run with everything you have. Real races are so much more fun than I ever dreamed.
choice_data_list: And there are still even more wonderful views waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You mean… even more wonderful than what I've seen so far?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: But everything is already so amazing.
choice_data_list: The best is yet to come.
The best is yet to come.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She still doesn't know what a high-level race is like. What she sees from the highest stages will no doubt take her breath away.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I see. My heart can pound even harder…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Wonderful views, huh?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I wonder what kind of race I need to run to see them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Fine Motion mutters those words, her eyes sparkle in the evening glow of the setting sun.
